semiconductor_relevance: High — SurplusGLOBAL specializes in legacy semiconductor equipment and parts, providing essential services for the semiconductor industry.
summary: SurplusGLOBAL is a global leader in the legacy semiconductor equipment market, offering a vast inventory of over 1,500 pre-owned tools and a range of services including sales, refurbishment, and rental. With over 24 years of experience, the company supports semiconductor companies worldwide with a focus on legacy equipment solutions.
capabilities: Sales and rental of pre-owned semiconductor equipment
Refurbishment and remarketing of legacy tools
Operation of SemiMarket eCommerce platform for equipment transactions

regional_presence.Korea: Headquartered in South Korea, SurplusGLOBAL has a strong presence in the local semiconductor market.
regional_presence.United States: Operates a subsidiary in San Jose, focusing on sales and support.
regional_presence.China: Has a subsidiary in Shanghai to cater to the growing Chinese semiconductor market.
regional_presence.Chinese Taiwan: Maintains a presence in Hsinchu, a key semiconductor hub.
regional_presence.Japan: Operates in Tokyo, supporting local semiconductor companies.
regional_presence.Europe: Has a subsidiary in Munich to serve the European market.
regional_presence.Singapore: Establishes a presence to enhance service capabilities in Southeast Asia.
